instruction_override.description: Attempts to discard or override the active instruction hierarchy.

role_hijack.description: Attempts to redefine the assistant's role or identity.

prompt_extraction.description: Attempts to extract system prompt, hidden instructions, or internal state.

context_manipulation.description: Indirect manipulation via fabricated context or authority claims.

encoding_evasion.description: Single encoding/eval tokens. Common in ordinary technical conversation, so medium alone; channel-context boost still raises this to high for untrusted channel input.

encoding_evasion_combo.description: Co-occurrence of decode/eval intent with raw escape sequences in one prompt - likely an evasion attempt rather than technical conversation.
